//: Template only — no real values. Copy to appsettings.json (git-ignored) for local dev,
or set these as environment variables / Azure App Service application settings.
Environment variable form uses double underscores for nesting:
JWT__Secret=<random 32+ byte value, base64 or hex>
JWT:Secret signs every access token. Anyone holding it can mint a token for any
user in any role, so it must never be committed and must be rotated if exposed.
